messages:
lee: heads-up: hit a weird failure when running node sampleapp against local rerank server. one batch shows a 400 'vector-length-mismatch' and then our sampleapp retry middleware resends -> duplicates.

lee: quick repro: concat float32 buffers, base64 encode, POST. occasionally decoded payload is shorter by a few bytes.

lee: snippet:
```js
const raw = Buffer.concat(vecs.map(v => Buffer.from(new Float32Array(v).buffer)));
const payload = { model: 'redwood-embed-001', data: raw.toString('base64') };
await fetch('/embed', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
```

noor: curious whether any step trims trailing zero bytes when building the JSON string. Buffer.toString('base64') shouldn't. any custom base64 lib in the test harness?

lee: no, using Node core. I logged raw.length before encode = 4096, after decode on server side = 4092 in one run.

sam: two angles: 1) client/SDK should validate vector lengths before sending; 2) sampleapp retry rules are too broad (treating all 4xx as retryable). structural 4xx like bad payload must not be retried.

maria: agreed. SDK guard is quick: if vec.length !== expectedDim -> throw or expose pad/truncate strategy. Transparent padding by default is risky.

lee: my local temp fix was padVectors(vecs, expectedDim) so tests continue, but that's hiding the bug.

noor: also noticed parity in rerank response format: python wrapper returns objects with explicit `id` fields, node wrapper returned plain arrays. that causes mapping fragility after dedupe. we should standardize to always include ids server-side or normalize in SDK.

sam: i'll open a small PR to the JS SDK to add validateVectors config: { mode: 'strict'|'pad'|'truncate' } and to stop retrying on 400 vector-dim errors.

ci-bot: PR #911 opened by sam: "js-sdk: vector validation + narrow 4xx retry policy"  checks queued.

maria: let's add a tiny integration test that runs node+python sampleapps against a local server and compares response shapes and embedding counts. include a fuzz run that toggles base64 vs JSON array paths. add to CI matrix.

lee: also tagging billing: this retry loop can double-submit and duplicate charges. cc @finance. :money_with_wings:

noor: another mitigation: server can mark structural errors with a flag in the error payload like `retryable:false` so clients can respect it even with broader retry policies. i'll propose that in a separate issue.

sam: created issue DEVEX-1187 for server error flag and DEVEX-1188 for parity integration test.

lee: thx for the quick triage. i'll attach a minimal gist with failing base64 case to the PR. will keep thread updated. :rocket:
